$comment: CLEAR's operating rhythm as ceremony definitions (ADR-0059): the six meetings from the 'Meeting Culture & Operating Rhythm' page, names only, no ids and no secrets. Import through Settings → Ceremonies → Import JSON (owner/admin), then run 'Backfill attachments' as a dry run before committing. Owner/participant names resolve against workspace members; an unresolved name falls back to the importer. Cadences are the best reading of the inventory and the recorded evidence (Cycle 14 planning on Thu 20 Aug 2026); edit before importing if the calendar says otherwise. ownerName is matched against workspace members by exact name OR email, so emails are used here: CLEAR's display names ('Andi ', 'Zineb Bhaby') do not match the inventory's wording, and an unresolved name silently falls back to whoever ran the import. Zineb has two member records (z.bhaby@gmail.com and zineb.bhaby@nrc.no) — the named one is used; swap it if the NRC account is the right owner.

definitions.name: Daily Standup
definitions.purpose: Surface blockers and align on today's priorities in fifteen minutes.
definitions.notFor:
- Prioritisation debates: they belong in Product Prioritisation
- Design discussions
- Status reports for their own sake
definitions.inputs:
- Each participant's Actions completed since the last standup
- Anything flagged as blocked
definitions.outputs:
- Every blocker has an owner
- Parking-lot topics carried to the right ceremony

definitions.name: Product Prioritisation
definitions.purpose: Decide what the team works on next, with the evidence in the room, so standups stop turning into this meeting.
definitions.inputs:
- Open and proposed Decisions
- Objectives and key results at risk
- Candidate features and insights
definitions.outputs:
- An ordered backlog for the next planning
- Decisions logged, with rationale

definitions.name: Cycle Planning
definitions.purpose: Commit the team to a realistic scope for the next cycle from an already-prioritised backlog.
definitions.notFor:
- Discovering priorities (Product Prioritisation)
- Estimating everything in the backlog
definitions.inputs:
- Prioritised backlog
- Capacity for the cycle
- Carry-over from the last cycle
definitions.outputs:
- A committed cycle with owners on every ticket
- Explicit deferrals

definitions.name: Review & Demo
definitions.purpose: Show what shipped, against what was committed, to the people who asked for it.
definitions.notFor:
- Retrospective discussion of how the work went
- Planning the next cycle
definitions.inputs:
- Tickets closed this cycle
- Working software to demo
definitions.outputs:
- Feedback captured as Actions or tickets
- Acceptance or rework decisions

definitions.name: Retrospective
definitions.purpose: Improve how the team works by turning last cycle's friction into a few owned actions.
definitions.inputs:
- Actions from the previous retrospective, with status
- Cycle metrics
definitions.outputs: - At most three improvement Actions, each with an owner and a date

definitions.name: All Hands
definitions.purpose: Keep everyone aligned on direction, progress and what changed since last time.
definitions.notFor:
- Team-level detail
- Decisions that need a smaller room
definitions.inputs:
- Objective progress
- Decisions made since the last all-hands
definitions.outputs: - Questions captured and answered or owned
